newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 23.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Front page story details Deng Xiaoping's concept of "one country, two systems" and hails importance of that principle to Hong Kong's future development and reunification of the motherland.
- Officials see 118 billion kg summer grain harvest, up 3.5 percent increase or four billion kg from 1996. This is the third consecutive year China has had a good summer grain harvest.
- Editorial says Hong Kong return to the motherland can set an example to solve the Taiwan problem
- About 40 couples hold mass wedding in Zhengzhou in Henan province to mark Hong Kong return to China
- Deposits of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China reach 140.1 billion yuan in first quarter, up 7.3 percent from year ago
- People's Liberation Army bank and honour guard leave for Hong Kong to take part in the handover ceremony
- Sales to production ratio of industry up 0.31 percent year-on-year in May
- Only 24 percent of China's urban population drink water that reaches the bacteriological standard
- Agricultural Development Bank sees 16.3 billion yuan shortfall in purchases of summer grain, oils
- Survey of loss-making firms finds 76.3 percent blame revolving capital difficulties for suspension of production or operations at below capacity
- Part of the 18.5-km underground railway route in southern Guangzhou will be operational this weekend
